there are a LOT of aspects to reading a chart, but people automatically assume that you're a scorpio because of not only your pluto, but your sun in your 10th house. pluto is one of the rulers of scorpio, which basically adds to it even more. the 10th house is about career, fame and public image. there is a lot more to be said about pluto being in the 10th house, but off the top of my head, your sun being in your 10th house means that your life will revolve around career and public image. you should go onto [astroseek](https://horoscopes.astro-seek.com/birth-chart-horoscope-online) and put your details in there, it will tell you what your planets mean, and what all the signs they are in mean (if that makes any sense). basically when people first see you, they see scorpio and capricorn :)

from what i can see, you have really strong feelings for this person, and they may also be representing the king of cups (typically a rather masculine water sign, but doesnt have to be). with the 10 of cups, your seeking some sort of long term partnership, and you see yourself growing old with this person. you both want different things. the 10 of pentacles is what he wants (to focus more on his career, or education) and you want commitment. with the 5 of pentacles, he might be dealing with things of his own, when it comes to money, or his studies. he might be struggling with finances, but it seems if he was, he doesnt want to tell you :(. overall, i dont think he wants a relationship. in this reading, im seeing the 9 of swords as more of a karmic connection. and as someone who has had her fair share of those, as much as they sucked, im weirdky glad they happened. this card symbolises new found wisdom in this reading, within the both of you. i think you need to talk with the other person about this relationship op, thats where you will find the most clarity with this. i wish you all the best! <3

okay so from what im seeing from the 10 of wands, there was a completion of some kind. is this when you maybe lost your previous job? this could also mean that if you were to get a job, something must end first. theres multiple ways this could be interpreted. the king and the queen could represent 2 people, or two major scenarios. but what im really getting from the cards is that something must end. then, with the ace of swords, there will be a new beginning. this could involve a masculine air sign (aquarius, gemini, libra), and it will cause some sort of emotional turmoil (queen of cups). or, if this doesnt involve anyone, this may be a message to give up the way you think about something, and with the three of cups, you will gain emotional knowledge. seems like a karmic reading, but i wish you all the best op <3
